market_view: VIX 16.5 and falling over five days, S&P 500 at records on a broad earnings beat; crude fell 5.7% on Strait of Hormuz reopening hopes, 10-year yield 4.63.

oil_gas.reasoning: Crude -5.7% on Hormuz reopening hopes is a driver move already happened; Trump attack on Exxon and Chevron profits is a policy overhang, not a long case. No unpriced upside catalyst.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold +1.5% and NEM +2.5% already moved; gold below 200-day average, yields high. No headline for miners.

chips.reasoning: Sector rebounded (+8.7% in five days); the only chip headlines are AMD falling after earnings and NVDA product blog posts, nothing NVDA-specific and unpriced.

pharma.catalyst: 'Lilly reports second-quarter 2026 financial results, raises full-year guidance, and highlights continued growth and pipeline progress' (Eli Lilly, published 2026-08-05 07:00 UTC, before the US open, so the reaction is not in the closes). LLY is down 8.6% in five days into the print, so a guidance raise is a clear one-sided setup.
pharma.reasoning: Guidance raise is a named catalyst released before the open; stock fell into it. Risk: the market may already have expected it and sell the news, so confidence is only modestly above the bar.

copper_uranium.reasoning: FCX +5.75% in a day and +13% in 20 days; copper near its high. Energy Fuels results and World Nuclear News producer updates are relevant to CCJ, not the FCX leader. No FCX guidance headline.

would_change_my_mind: Lilly guidance turning out already expected (stock falling on the print) would lower the pharma call; an Iran re-escalation or an FCX guidance or outage headline would open oil or copper longs.

handoff.what_changed: Lilly reported Q2 and raised full-year guidance before the US open on 2026-08-05 after LLY fell 8.6% in five days; I went long LLY. Crude fell another 5.7% on Strait of Hormuz reopening hopes, and Trump criticised Exxon and Chevron profits. Chips and copper continued strongly higher, AMD slid after earnings.

oil_gas.why: Crude down on Hormuz reopening hopes, no unpriced catalyst for XOM.

gold_miners.why: NEM up already, gold below 200-day average, no catalyst.

chips.why: Sector rebound priced, no NVDA-specific catalyst.

pharma.why: Q2 results with a full-year guidance raise released pre-open after a 8.6% five-day drop.

copper_uranium.why: FCX +5.75% and copper near high already priced; no FCX-specific headline.
